title: PairIT: Autoregressive Transformers for Low-Data Molecule Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.19123v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generating novel molecules with desired properties is a central challenge in drug discovery. Although foundational work focused on de novo generation, practical use cases require a more complex setting: conditioning on an initial seed molecule, optimizing multiple properties, and operating in data-sparse regimes. We introduce PairIT, a flexible training framework for autoregressive transformers over SMILES sequences that enables seeded generation by learning from pairs of structurally similar molecules. By leveraging matched pairs, the model learns to generate local, chemically meaningful edits that improve a property of the seed molecule. Prompt tokens extend this framework by specifying the target property, desired direction, and approximate magnitude of change. translated_title: PairIT：用于低数据分子优化的自回归Transformer
translated_abstract: 生成具有目标性质的新型分子是药物发现中的核心挑战。尽管早期的基础性工作主要集中于从头生成，但实际应用场景需要更复杂的设定：以一个初始种子分子为条件、同时优化多种性质，并在数据稀缺的条件下运行。我们提出了PairIT，这是一个面向SMILES序列自回归Transformer的灵活训练框架，通过从结构相似的分子对中学习来实现基于种子分子的生成。通过利用匹配的分子对，模型学会生成局部的、化学上有意义的编辑，从而改进种子分子的某种性质。提示词进一步扩展了这一框架，可以指定目标性质、期望的改变方向以及大致的改变幅度。多个提示词可以拼接使用，从而在推理阶段实现多性质优化。对于仅靠分子对监督不足以学好的性质，则采用强化学习……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了PairIT框架，通过从结构相似分子对中学习来训练SMILES自回归Transformer，实现低数据条件下的种子分子性质优化，并借助提示词在推理时支持多性质联合优化。
en_tdlr: PairIT is a flexible training framework for autoregressive transformers over SMILES that learns from pairs of structurally similar molecules to enable low-data, seeded molecule optimization, with prompt tokens supporting multi-property optimization at inference time.
